_comment: Lists in message bodies and canvases (DATA_MODEL.md 「本文の形式」, 2026-10-06), the same in the three clients: markdown.ts listItems (MessageBody.tsx draws nested <ol start> / <ul>), MessageBodyView.swift BodyTokenizer.listItems, BodyTokenizer.kt listItems. A list is a run of lines starting with "- " / "* " / "• " or "1. " (up to three digits); any other line, a blank one too, ends it. An item indented 2 or more columns past the item before nests one level deeper (2–4 spaces or a tab, which counts 4); a smaller indent goes back to the level it matches; three levels at most (deeper stays at the third). Each run of items of one kind at one level under one parent is a list of its own: it starts at the number its first item is written with ("3." starts at 3) and counts on by one whatever the others say; a nested list starts again under every parent item, a run of the other kind at the same level starts again, and at the top level the other kind is a new list block. Markers: numbers 1. / a. / i. by level (aa. after z.; below 1 a number stays decimal), bullets • / ◦ / ▪. `blocks`: the kinds of the body's blocks; `lists`: each list block's items as [level, marker, text].

_quoted: Lists inside a quote (2026-10-08: "> - item" showed the "-"). A quote is a run of lines starting with ">" (one space after it is dropped, ">- a" works too); a line without ">" ends it — no lazy continuation, since a reply often follows a quote on the next line. Its lines are read as at the top level, as paragraphs and lists only: a run of list lines is a list (levels, numbers and markers as above, the other kind at the top a new list, bullets drawn as dot / ring / square), any other line — a blank one too — a paragraph line. `blocks`: the kinds of the body's blocks; `quotes`: each quote's blocks in order, ["list", [[level, marker, text]…]] or ["paragraph", [line text…]].
